synthetic_generated_with_noise.name: Artificial family A (27 sets, no outliers)
synthetic_generated_with_noise.note: Two 5-D standard normal distributions; full factorial IR {5,10,25} x size {500,1000,2500} x majority centre {[3,3,3,3,3],[1.7x5],[1.5x5]} (minority centre [0,0,0,0,0]) = 27 sets; individual sets not n

synthetic_generated_with_noise.name: Artificial family B (27 sets with outliers)
synthetic_generated_with_noise.note: Same 27 as family A but 10 percent of instances of each class replaced by instances from the opposite class; total 54 artificial sets

synthetic_generated_with_noise.name: simulated set (Fig. S2)
synthetic_generated_with_noise.note: simulated imbalanced set: 60 minority samples, 584 majority samples and 6 noisy minority samples inside the majority region (supp. S5, p.11); the minority subclusters have different covariance (p.12);
